privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Pazzwrd is committed to maintaining the highest standards of data privacy and security. This Privacy Policy outlines the institutional protocols and technical measures employed to safeguard user information.
privacy.masterPasswordDesc: The Master Password serves as the primary cryptographic seed for the user's digital vault. It is utilized to derive unique encryption keys for the protection of sensitive credentials and financial data. Pazzwrd adheres to a strict non-custodial policy; the Master Password is never transmitted to or stored on our infrastructure.
privacy.encryptionDetail: Data integrity is maintained through the implementation of industry-standard XChaCha20-Poly1305 encryption. Each vault entry is secured with an individual key, which is subsequently wrapped using a key-encryption-key (KEK) derived from the user's Master Password.
privacy.storageDesc: Pazzwrd provides multi-layered storage solutions to ensure data availability and security:
privacy.localStorage: On-Device Storage: Encrypted data is persisted locally on the user's device, facilitating offline access while maintaining cryptographic security.
privacy.cloudStorage: Cloud Synchronization: Upon user authorization, encrypted datasets are synchronized with our secure cloud infrastructure to enable cross-platform accessibility.
privacy.publicDataDesc: Information is categorized based on sensitivity to optimize performance while ensuring maximum security:
privacy.privateData: Classified Data: All sensitive records, including passwords, payment information, and private notes, are encrypted locally prior to transmission or storage.
privacy.publicData: Metadata: Non-sensitive metadata (e.g., service identifiers or organizational labels) may be stored in a non-encrypted format to facilitate efficient indexing and retrieval operations.
privacy.zeroKnowledgeDesc: Our systems operate under a Zero-Knowledge architecture. The server functions exclusively as a secure repository for encrypted payloads. The service provider possesses no technical means to access encryption keys, Master Passwords, or decrypted user content. This architectural design ensures that data remains inaccessible to unauthorized parties, including the service provider.
privacy.warningDesc: Due to the implementation of end-to-end encryption and the Zero-Knowledge model, the recovery of a lost Master Password is technically impossible by the service provider. Failure to retain the Master Password will result in the permanent loss of access to all encrypted data. Users are strictly advised to maintain secure backups of their Master Password.

faq.whatIsCloudDesc: Cloud means that your encrypted data is synchronized with our secure servers. This allows you to access your passwords and cards from any device by logging into your account.
faq.whatIsLocalDesc: Local means that your data is stored only on your device. It is encrypted and never leaves your phone unless you enable cloud synchronization.
faq.howDataStoredTitle: How are passwords and card details stored?
faq.howDataStoredDesc: In both cloud and local storage, your data is always encrypted using industry-standard protocols. Only you hold the key (your Master Password) to decrypt this information.
faq.whatIsMPDesc: MP stands for Master Password. It is the single password you use to access your vault. We never store your Master Password, so it's crucial that you don't forget it.
faq.trashRulesDesc: When you delete a password or card, it goes to the Trash tab. Items in the Trash will be permanently deleted after a certain period, or you can manually empty it.
faq.howToDeleteTitle: How do I delete a password or card?
faq.howToDeleteDesc: To delete a password or card, go to the passwords or cards page and hold click (long press) on the item you want to delete. A delete option will appear.
faq.howToRestoreTitle: Can I restore items from Trash?
faq.howToRestoreDesc: Yes, you can restore any card or password from the Trash tab back to your main vault at any time before it is permanently deleted.
faq.howToShareTitle: How does the share password feature work?
faq.howToShareDesc: You can securely share passwords with other users. The shared password remains encrypted and only the intended recipient can access it.
